description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for managing candidate history records within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It provides methods to list, retrieve, and update candidate history entries, with detailed request validation, access control, and interaction with the data layer.

classes.name: CandidateHistoryAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for listing, retrieving, and updating candidate history records in the recruitment module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list candidate history records with filtering and pagination.

methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method, including candidate ID access validation.
